description: Na₃WO₃N is beta beryllia-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmn2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent WNO₃ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.33 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form NaNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent WNO₃ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The Na-N bond length is 2.33 Å. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and two longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. W is bonded to one N and three O atoms to form WNO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaNO₃ tetrahedra. The W-N bond length is 1.79 Å. All W-O bond lengths are 1.87 Å. N is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form NNa₃W tetrahedra that share corners with twelve ONa₃W tetrahedra. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form distorted ONa₃W tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NNa₃W tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent ONa₃W tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form ONa₃W tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NNa₃W tetrahedra and corners with eight ONa₃W tetrahedra.
